Descriptions

Three lengths, in English and Spanish. Copy whichever suits you; we only ask that you credit the studio.

Singular es un roguelike de acción top-down, rápido, en el que la SANGRE es tu único recurso. Te curas y recargas bañándote en la que derramas. El bucle nunca cambiará… a menos que lo MATES.
Singular is a fast top-down action roguelike where BLOOD is your only resource. You heal and reload by bathing in what you spill. The loop will never change… unless you KILL IT.
Singular es un roguelike de acción top-down, rápido y en pixel art, en el que la sangre es tu único recurso: te curas y recargas bañándote en la que derramas, así que dudar significa morir. Controlas a Ari, una chatarrera en una ciudad que olvidó su propio nombre, a través de un mundo vasto y abandonado donde los jefes te acechan entre partidas. Pero el bucle que te mantiene atrapada sólo se rompe cuando empiezas a dudar de él.
Singular is a fast top-down action roguelike where blood is your only resource. You heal and reload by bathing in what you spill, so hesitating means dying. You play Ari, a scavenger in a city that forgot its own name, moving through a vast abandoned world where bosses stalk you across runs. But the loop that keeps you trapped only breaks when you start doubting it.
Singular es un roguelike de acción top-down, rápido y en pixel art artesanal, en el que la sangre es tu único recurso. Te curas y recargas únicamente bañándote en la sangre de los enemigos mientras cae. Quedarse quieto mata: los enemigos aparecen según tu posición, acampar invoca hordas de castigo y casi todas las paredes se rompen. No hay esquinas seguras. Velocidad es supervivencia. Bajo la velocidad hay profundidad. Overheat castiga el exceso de confianza; Trauma convierte cada error en daño que no se cura; la esquiva perfecta abre ventanas de combo que reducen ambos. Tres sistemas que se cruzan y premian leer el combate, no aporrear botones. Fácil de sobrevivir, brutal de dominar. Los jefes no esperan en su sala. Las Entidades Persistentes son superjefes errantes que pueden entrar en cualquier habitación, se marchan a los pocos segundos y conservan el daño entre partidas: la misma criatura, una y otra vez, hasta que cae. Con Skip&Kill puedes saltarte un jefe para llegar a salas más duras y mejor botín, o ganarte el único objeto capaz de matarlo para siempre. Y entre combate y combate, sin romper el ritmo, una historia críptica y reactiva. Controlas a Ari, una chatarrera en una ciudad que olvidó su propio nombre, en un mundo vasto, vacío y abandonado, entre biología y máquina. El tiempo pasa; los personajes lo notan y reaccionan. Ari, tu habilidad y la historia crecen juntas fallando, muriendo y empujando hacia delante. Porque el bucle sólo se rompe cuando empiezas a dudar de él.
Singular is a fast top-down action roguelike in handcrafted pixel art where blood is your only resource. You heal and reload only by bathing in enemies' blood as it falls. Standing still is death: enemies spawn depending on your position, camping triggers punishment waves and almost every wall is breakable. No safe corners. Speed is survival. Under the speed there is depth. Overheat punishes overcommitting; Trauma turns every mistake into damage you can't heal back; a frame-perfect dodge opens a combo window that reduces both. Three interlocking systems that reward reading the fight, not mashing buttons. Easy to survive, brutal to master. Bosses don't wait in their room. Persistent Entities are roaming super-bosses that can wander into any room, leave after a few seconds and keep their damage between runs: the same entity again and again, until it falls. With Skip&Kill you can skip a boss to reach harder rooms and better loot, or earn the one item that can kill it for good. And between fights, without ever breaking flow, a cryptic, reactive story. You play Ari, a scavenger in a city that forgot its own name, in a vast, empty, abandoned world caught between biology and machine. Time passes; the characters notice and react. Ari, your skill and the story grow together by failing, dying and pushing forward. Because the loop only breaks when you start doubting it.

Pillars and mechanics

Four systems, one idea: everything pushes you to attack, and everything you do leaves a mark.

Aggressive combat

Heal and reload only by spilling blood. Enemies spawn based on your position; camping summons punishment hordes. Almost every wall is destructible. Dash and OverClock chain attacks into forward momentum.

Overheat

Punishes overconfidence. Too long in OverClock damages and stuns Ari. It forces a decision mid-fight.

Trauma

Punishes mistakes. A percentage of the damage you take can't be healed for a few seconds. Perfect dodges and melee kills reduce it.

Perfect dodge

Rewards aggression. A frame-perfect dash, chained with OverClock and an attack, opens a combo window. It reduces Trauma and Overheat.

Persistent Entities

Roaming super-bosses that can enter any room. Huge health pools; they leave after a few seconds. You meet them again and again across runs.

Skip&Kill

Skip a boss room to reach harder rooms and better loot. Go deep enough, win a special encounter and earn an Oxidiser: the only way to permanently kill that level's boss.

World, narrative and art

Narrative in motion

Exploration and ambiguity. The story moves forward through coincidence and exploration. We want to hook the player with ambiguity, and to connect with the player by asking questions.

Subtle delivery. Quick dialogue and small scenes at specific moments. No constant stops. Everything is cryptic; putting the pieces together is the player's job.

Emotional impact. A deep, reactive narrative that responds to the player's choices, often non-linearly. Every character and every boss has a flaw and a story behind them.

Cyclical meaning. A story about meaning and growth through failing, achieving, dying and living. Ari learns to be human: from following orders to growing up and deciding for herself.

Time, space and change. Light cycles, character availability and special encounters give the sense that time passes. Small choices affect the world.

Art direction

World and tone. Vast, empty and abandoned, full of ancient, useless technology. Melancholy, biology and machinery. The living and the dead, the physical and the ethereal.

Scale. Enormous bosses. Enormous stages. Enormous amounts of time.

Style. Handcrafted pixel art. It helps the game stand out, and it suits the melancholy.

Minimal interface. No conventional UI cluttering the screen. A world you feel before you understand it.

Ari. A scavenger in a city that forgot its own name, moving between scaffolding, signal and silence. Palette: teal and iridescent.

On the title. Singular: a point, event or condition so extreme that the rules governing the situation no longer apply. From the Late Latin singularitas: uniqueness, solitude.

Iterum Corporation

An independent Spanish studio, deliberately small, built for this production. Its first title is Singular.

The corporate identity is a serious joke: a fictional megacorporation that exists to make a small, dense game. Iterum means again. The emblem is a serpent biting its own tail, run through by a sword.

Singular was born from a sudden stop and a question, where am I, and where am I going?, in the fastest-changing world in history. It speaks of technology and its consequences for us, of the purpose many cannot find, of a time that no longer feels like ours; of breaking the loop, growing through pain, falling and fighting again.
